title: Home and Away Presence Thrash Detection
dataSources: Home Assistant state/logbook events (`homeassistant:event`), Homey flow/insights (`homey:flow`), SmartThings events (`smartthings:event`), Hubitat/openHAB logs, Node-RED flow events (`nodered:event`).
app: Home Assistant / Homey / SmartThings / Hubitat / openHAB event streams via MQTT, webhooks, and REST - forwarded to Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=homeassistant:event event_type=presence_update
| bin _time span=1d
| stats count as transitions by person _time
| where transitions>8
| sort - transitions
description: Counts how often presence status flips between home and away, exposing the geofence and Wi-Fi edge cases that make occupancy automations annoying.
value: Presence logic only feels magical when it is stable; thrash counts point directly to the people or phones creating false entries and exits.
implementation: Forward presence-update events from your platform; review daily and tune geofences or trackers with excessive flip counts.
visualization: Daily table of people by home/away transition count.
grandmaExplanation: It logs when your phone or tracker keeps wrongly saying you arrived and left over and over.
